difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the Gysin map commutes with the proper pushforward of the ambient scheme, on the level of cycles (statement lines 5263-5281, tag 02TN-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class and distinguishes whether it is contained in the base changed divisor, using the comparison of first Chern classes as cycles in both cases, and then extends the equality to general cycles by the infinite sums statement. The two-case analysis is the substance, so the claim is H2.
